title: Machine Health Summary v0
description: Research-oriented machine health summary based on simulated NASA C-MAPSS data.

machine_id.description: Readable machine identifier, not the internal database UUID.

cycle.description: Observed operating-cycle index, not a timestamp.

estimate.description: Estimated remaining useful life in cycles.

coverage_level.description: Nominal conformal coverage level; not a per-prediction guarantee.

interval.description: Omit when a calibrated interval is unavailable.

at_cap.description: Whether the estimate is at the configured RUL cap.

probability.description: Estimated probability that RUL is less than or equal to threshold_cycles; not automatically a real-world failure probability.

rul_threshold_probability.description: Omit until the estimation method is implemented and evaluated.

risk_level.description: Configured risk category, included when risk classification is implemented.

thresholds_version.description: Version of the risk-threshold configuration that produced risk_level. Present if and only if risk_level is present.

trend.description: Omit when trend analysis is unavailable.

shap_value.description: SHAP attribution for the specified feature and explained model output.

effect_on_rul.description: Optional; include only when the direction mapping is implemented and validated.

top_contributors.description: Omit when SHAP results are unavailable.

recommendation.description: Optional research-oriented investigation suggestion from a documented decision rule.

generated_at.description: Application-generated UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

disclaimer.const: Research-oriented decision support based on simulated C-MAPSS data and retrieved technical knowledge.
